hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom AMM hook backed by Euler vault positions. Swaps are fully handled in beforeSwap: input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault, output tokens are withdrawn from another Euler vault, and a BeforeSwapDelta is returned to override Uniswap v4's standard pricing. Uses a custom concentrated-liquidity curve (CurveLib) for pricing. Native v4 liquidity positions and donations are blocked.
